report.summary: Incident window shows payment-service receiving HTTP 429 TooManyRequests from gateway-mock on /authorize (D20,D22: 6 of 10 calls), recording 6 payments FAILED (D12,D53) with PAYMENT_FAILED orders (D10,D50).
